decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service sits on the home page, builds on core messaging infrastructure at low marginal cost, and its growth prospects are still unresolved, so the option is worth keeping.

Document capture has its own page and fits the electronic document workflow strategy, but it is a somewhat separate capability with more competition, so it carries moderate risk while its value is still uncertain.
Email-to-fax conversion reuses existing fax and email platforms at little carrying cost and serves regulated customers who still rely on fax.
This feature is close to the core fax delivery offer and costs almost nothing to keep, so dropping it releases few resources.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the security bundle in a growing market, and keeping it costs little while demand develops.
Multi-engine virus scanning is an inexpensive add-on to the existing email security service that supports the compliance positioning.
